title: Docs: Document new addon bundling strategy
body:
Works on https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/issues/24490

Depends on #24676 and https://github.com/storybookjs/addon-kit/pull/60

<!-- If your PR is related to an issue, provide the number(s) above; if it resolves multiple issues, be sure to break them up (e.g. "closes #1000, closes #1001"). -->

<!--

Thank you for contributing to Storybook! Please submit all PRs to the `next` branch unless they are specific to the current release. ## What I did

Briefly document the new split bundling strategy for addons. Any feedback on wording is welcome.

author: JReinhold

comments.author: jonniebigodes
comments.body: @JReinhold, one minor thing: when you have a moment, can you update to the correct file instead of a pull request? I'm aware that [this](https://github.com/storybookjs/addon-kit/pull/59) has yet to be merged but we should have the links targeting what's now the default pattern. WDYT?
comments.label_reasoning: The comment is requesting an update to documentation (MIGRATION.md) to point to the correct file/link rather than a pull request, which is a documentation accuracy issue.

comments.author: JReinhold
comments.body:
This was actually intentional. My thinking was to link to the diff, so that addon authors could follow along and do a similar diff. Instead of just linking to the final result.
But it's not a strong opinion of mine.

comments.author: jonniebigodes
comments.body: Ok then, I just thinking that you were just adding a placeholder link until the other pull request was merged. Thanks for the clarification.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment requests a specific change: updating a link to target the correct file instead of a pull request URL. It identifies a concrete modification needed in the documentation.

comments.author: JReinhold
comments.body: I'm unsure if this code snippet is too long now, and we should just link to the tsup config in the addon-kit and not have any code snippet at all. Then we wouldn't also need to keep the two in sync.

comments.author: kylegach
comments.body:
Yeah, that's pretty gnarly. And it's just demonstrating the default config, right?

I vote to get rid of it in the docs. 👍
